properties.notes: Former NCB workshops complex, comprising a number of industrial buildings, outbuildings and associated land. Following closure of Ashington Colliery in 1986, the site continued to be utilised as employment land and became a haulage depot for Fergusons. Following relocation of the business to new premises, this site was vacant and available for alternative use Demolition of the former workshop buildings and remediation of the site required prior to redevelopment. An application was allowed on appeal in 2003 for clearance of the site and construction of 357 new homes (00/00213/FUL). The application had originally been refused in 2001. Subsequently application to amend the initial scheme have been permitted since, increasing the final yield to 367 homes. The site has been slowly delivered over recent years and works are now reaching conclusion. Completion is forecast within the next 5 years.
properties.site-address: Former NCB Workshops (Portland Park), Ellington Road, Ashington
